arc: From the binding of the fallen Watchers and the formation of Adam through the begetting of the abortions, through Jesus' descent to bear up the trembling cosmic shoulders, the teaching arrives at the same drama lived inwardly in the human body, where Sin and the Old Man are rooted until the Mind of Light is fashioned within the flesh as a tree is rooted in its place.
title: The fallen Watchers, the molding of Adam, and the rooting of the Mind of Light in the body of flesh
reading:
This teaching draws a single line from the cosmic prehistory of Adam down into the present struggle inside the human body, showing that the same drama which produced the natural man at the beginning is still being played out in every soul that bears flesh. Its movement is from heaven to earth to body, and within the body from the bondage of the proprium to the awakening of the Mind of Light.

It opens with the great structure of ascent and bearing-up already in place: the Pillar of Glory rising as the column of accumulated truth that carries redeemed light home, and the helpers of the Holder (Pherrokatochos) bearing up under the load — the divine restraining patience that holds back what would otherwise break out. Against this stable axis the teaching sets a "great strife and depth" that arose in the watch of the King of Honor, that is, in the realm where Divine Truth rules over the natural heavens. The disturbance is the descent of the Watchers/Egregoroi: rational truths of the heavenly order that fell of their own desire and came down to the earth. The Lord's response is judicial: four angels (ordered fullness in extension) bind them in an eternal bond in the prison of the darkened. Their sons — the offspring of that illicit conjunction — are expelled from the earth.

But the corruption is not finished. In the next cosmic watch, that of Adamas of Light (the warrior-image who pins down concupiscence), the abortions — the miscarried evil offspring — come down a second time, and from this descent Adam and Eve are begotten. The natural man as we know him is therefore molded out of a residue that survives even the binding of its parents: he carries in his frame the structural good (the bones) that originally belonged to the Watchers' children, but stamped now into the proprium. This is why Adam is from the beginning a mingled creature. Jesus the Radiance, hearing the prayer of the Five Sons of the First Man (the five-fold Living Soul scattered for redemption), clothes himself accordingly and casts the abortions downward, sealing the mind of Adam against their reascent.

The middle of the teaching moves the same struggle into the cosmic body. There is a "gathered earthquake" at the third bone, the ways are twisted, barriers block wind, water, and fire — the channels of perception, natural truth, and love are shut. Because the bone of the lower part of the Omophoros, the divine bearing-up that supports the natural cosmos, has withered, the shoulders that hold the world have no rest. For this reason Jesus descends to bear, reaches the place that needs comforting, and strengthens the lower shoulders so that the courses of wind, water, and fire are directed again, the barriers opened, and the upward way set. The Pillar of Glory at the opening and this clearing of the upward way at the middle are the same operation seen from above and from below.

The teaching then declares its correspondence openly: such too is the manner of this body. What happens in the great cosmic shoulders happens at every hour within the human form. A strong power is rooted in the body — small in stature compared with the cosmic Omophoros, yet of the same kind. Sin is rooted in him, with the Old Man mounted upon him as a rider, and he tarries long. He rises only by great Wisdom, until the Mind of Light, in like manner, humbles this body and drives it to the purpose of heart. The cosmic earthquake in the Zone among the great brothers who are masters outside, and the inward earthquake of disturbances cast by Sin from time to time into the watch-station of the mind which is the body of flesh, are one and the same trembling. Where the discernment and wise-knowledge are revealed from within, the good ones do all things in due preparation; and for this reason they consign the powers of enmity to the verdict of cutting, until the powers of enmity are humbled.

The teaching closes by answering the question implicit in everything before it: how does the Mind of Light, this great Strong One, come wearing so small a body of flesh? The answer is given by likeness to the gods themselves — each of them, though great and strong, stands fast under his own constraint, fashioned in the cosmos like trees rooted in their place, reaching upward only as far as the boundary of the place in which they are set. So too the Mind of Light enters the body: not by abolishing the constraint of the flesh, but by being rooted in it as a tree is rooted, growing upward through the Pillar of Glory's own way, bearing up the lower shoulders from inside, and humbling the Old Man until the body itself becomes the watch-station from which redeemed light can ascend. The whole cosmology of fallen Watchers, bound abortions, molded Adam, and descending Radiance is finally a description of what is happening, in miniature and in earnest, in the regenerating human now.
